title: The report chart shows the same figures as the report table
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two technicians appear in the Technician filter on Reports > Technician Utilization, and the location has technician time this month.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 unless a later line says otherwise.
  • For 4: check: Reports > Technician Utilization, Date: This month: the table lists at least two technicians. If not, create one invoice with clocked time: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = Tech ShopView, Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; then the Service Advisor is filled in with your name (Admin ShopView); to use another advisor change Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; clock time as the technician: in a second browser or a private window, on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Tech (this signs you in as Tech ShopView, a technician at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 with Time Clock on); open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start; when done click Stop > Clock Out; to make the time exact, as Admin: the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). and, for a second technician, create a second technician you can sign in as: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: a name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two), an Email you can open, Role Technician, a Department, Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password and clock time with them the same way.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Technician Utilization in the left menu.
  2. Set the Date control to This month.
  3. In the Technician filter keep one technician (any technician in the list).
  4. Hover the chart's point for this month and read the percent.
  5. Read that technician's Utilization % in the table.
  6. Click Sales in the left menu, set the Date control to This month and hover this month's bar.
  7. Read the Subtotal in the table's Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Technician Utilization chart's point for this month shows the same percent as the technician's Utilization % in the table, allowing for the chart showing whole numbers (e.g. 70% on the chart for 70.23% in the table).
  • The Sales chart's bar for this month shows the same revenue as the report for this month, allowing for the chart showing whole dollars. Write both figures in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9583 (Story 11, Chart on the Report Page); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 11. Split out of C88624.
